preconditions.description: The number of categories must be between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= W <= 10 for W in category_word_counts)
preconditions.description: Each category must have between 1 and 10 associated words.

preconditions.expression: all(len(word) <= 30 and word.islower() for word in all_words)
preconditions.description: All words in the input must consist of at most 30 lowercase letters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the names of the suggested categories in lexicographical order.
At least one category must be suggested based on the input statement.
